hlpMibUpload: All uploaded files are kept in one folder, so a MIB may IMPORT another uploaded MIB. The MIBs shipped with the adapter (SNMPv2-MIB, RFC1213-MIB, ...) are always available.
hlpOptChunkSize: This parameter specifies the maximum oid count within one request.
hlpOptNoCloseOnError: Selecting this option will not close and reopen ther reader session on error.
hlpOptRawStates: Selecting this option enables creation of states containing raw data.
hlpOptTypeStates: Selecting this option enables creation of states containing type data.
hlpOptUseIp: Selecting this option causes the IP address to be used for state ids as in prior releases.
hlpOptUseMibNames: With this option the OID field also accepts a symbolic name like IF-MIB::ifDescr.1, and the object ids are built from the MIB symbol instead of from the OID name. Attention: switching this option changes the object ids of existing OIDs - the previous objects stay behind as orphans.
infoAuth: This panel allows the configuration of authorization data for use with SNMP v3. Each set of authorization data can be used at panel Devices and referenced by its id.
infoMib: Upload the MIB files of your devices here. The MIB browser below shows their contents and can read a device live, so that OIDs can be taken over into the OID sets without typing them.
infoOidMibNames: Option "Use MIB names" is active: the OID field also accepts symbolic names like IF-MIB::ifDescr.1, and the object ids are built from the MIB symbol instead of from the name.
infoOidSets: Add OIDs grouped by OID group names here. Those groups can be assigned to devices at panel Devices.
lblDevsInfo: No OIDs defined yet - add them on the "OID sets" tab or pick them in the MIB browser
lblOptNoCloseOnError: Do not close session on error
lblOptUseIp: Compatibility mode - use ip address for state ids
ttOptChunkSize: Maximum oid count within one request
ttOptNoCloseOnError: Do not close and reopen reader session on error
ttOptRawStates: Create states containing raw data encodes as json.
ttOptTypeStates: Create states containing type data of oids.
ttOptUseIp: Mark to use ip adress for state ids
ttOptUseMibNames: Allow symbolic OIDs and name the objects after the MIB
warnAuthUnused: Note: Configuration at this panel will not be used currently as no device uses SNMPv3 protocol.
